mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 2.0% signals weakening aggregate demand, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls below 2.0% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in weakening demand periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 3.5% signals accelerating economic activity, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings expectations rise.

failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accelerating activity periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
